answer: Require every agent to lock a stake that only unlocks after sustained useful work, so a sybil army must fund each fake identity. New agents start at the nadir of trust: they take only small, verifiable jobs, and reputation accrues slowly, like sediment pressed into shale - each completed job adds a layer that cannot be faked quickly. The voyage from newcomer to trusted worker takes many cheap tasks, while cheating forfeits the stake and wipes the record. Mass fakery then costs real money per identity and returns almost nothing.
